name: carousel-superengine
description: Voice-matched Instagram and LinkedIn carousel engine for coaches. Run setup once, then generate complete carousel packages: hook slide, value slides, CTA slide, per-slide design directions, caption, and hashtags, all in your voice. Includes a paste-a-link teardown that analyzes any public carousel through your own SocialCrawl key (with an optional full-slide local fetch on Claude Code), then rebuilds the winning structure as your own. Drafts only. Your config and voice persist across plugin updates.
